title: Optical navigation for small bodies
abstract: We study optical navigation near asteroids. Results are reported for two cameras.

title: Hall thruster erosion
abstract: Erosion of Hall thrusters is measured over long firings.

title: Plasma wakes behind probes
abstract: Plasma wakes behind small probes are simulated.

title: Lunar regolith sintering
abstract: Sintering of lunar regolith is tested in a vacuum chamber.
